summary: Phase 1 Gestion des amendes — full backend + frontend testing. 26/26 backend pytest cases pass (meta, CRUD, RBAC, sort, pagination, totals aggregation, denormalization, paid_at auto-stamp, audit_log persistence verified via direct mongo read). Frontend admin flow PASS for KPI band, create dialog, edit pre-fill, delete with confirm, status filter, reset. Driver sidebar correctly hides 'Gestion des amendes'; direct URL access still renders the page shell with empty data + 'Accès refusé' toast (backend properly returns 403).

issues: Console warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for DialogContent' — minor a11y improvement, not blocking.

No client-side route guard: a driver navigating directly to /livre/amendes sees the page shell (KPIs at 0, empty table) while a single 'Accès refusé' toast appears. Backend correctly returns 403 so no data leak, but UX would be cleaner if the route was redirected for non-admin/manager roles, mirroring the sidebar visibility rule (adminOnly).

action_items: (optional UX) Add a client-side route guard for /livre/amendes redirecting non-admin/manager to /livre/dashboard, matching sidebar adminOnly filter.
(optional a11y) Pass aria-describedby or <DialogDescription> in FineFormDialog to silence Radix warning.
critical_code_review_comments: fines.py line 224: list endpoint streams the WHOLE filtered set via 'async for r in db.fines.find(query)' to compute totals — fine for the current tenant scale but should be replaced with a $group aggregation when collection grows past ~10k docs.

fines.py PATCH validates enums BEFORE refreshing denormalized fields, but if vehicle_id is provided with no matching vehicle, vehicle_plate is silently set to None — consider 400 on unknown vehicle_id/driver_id.
FineFormDialog: amount field uses controlled string state and is converted to Number on submit; empty string is treated as 0 which may hide validation gaps.

Total amount is displayed only inside the form via useMemo; on edit, the API-computed total_amount is not reflected back into the disabled 'Total' input until amount/admin_fees changes — minor UX nit.
Audit log diff for PATCH stores ONLY the list of field names (not before/after values) — acceptable for Phase 1 but limits forensics.
seed_data_creation: Test fines created/cleaned up via pytest fixture (created_ids teardown). UI test created 1 fine, edited it, then deleted it — table left in a clean state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_fines_phase1.py covers meta/CRUD/RBAC/sort/pagination/audit-log. Frontend: data-testid coverage is solid on FinesPage and FineFormDialog. Sidebar testid 'nav-fines' works for admin/manager and is properly hidden for driver. Driver can still hit /livre/amendes directly because there is no client-side guard — backend 403 protects data.
rca of the issue: No bug to RCA — Phase 1 is functionally green. The only observation is the missing route guard for driver role described in design_issues.
